name: Routine Request with Available Appointment Slot (Happy Path)
description: Patient seeking routine general practice checkup with mild symptoms (urgencyScore=2). DMN evaluates to Routine. Scheduling API returns 3 available slots. Automated booking confirmed.

inputVariables.symptomsSummary: Annual routine physical and preventive blood panel review

expectedRoute: StartEvent_AppointmentRequested -> Task_ValidatePatientRegistration -> Gateway_RegistrationValid (Valid) -> Task_EvaluatePatientTriageDmn -> Gateway_TriageBranch (Routine) -> Task_QueryAvailableSlotsRest -> Gateway_SlotAvailability (Routine Available) -> Task_AutoBookAppointment -> Task_SendAppointmentConfirmation -> EndEvent_AppointmentConfirmed

name: Request Routed for Priority Staff Review
description: Patient presenting with moderate persistent abdominal discomfort (urgencyScore=6). DMN evaluates to Priority Review (4h SLA). Scheduling API returns slots. Routed to Tasklist User Task for clinical staff review.

inputVariables.symptomsSummary: Persistent right-lower quadrant abdominal pain for 48 hours with mild fever

expectedRoute: StartEvent_AppointmentRequested -> Task_ValidatePatientRegistration -> Gateway_RegistrationValid (Valid) -> Task_EvaluatePatientTriageDmn -> Gateway_TriageBranch (Standard) -> Task_QueryAvailableSlotsRest -> Gateway_SlotAvailability (Priority Review) -> Task_PriorityStaffReview (Tasklist) [Confirmed] -> Task_SendAppointmentConfirmation -> EndEvent_AppointmentConfirmed

name: Urgent-Assessment Routed to Immediate Human Assessment
description: Patient with acute crushing chest pressure and dyspnea (urgencyScore=9, CRITICAL). DMN evaluates to Urgent Assessment (15 min SLA). Bypasses scheduling API; routes immediately to emergency team Tasklist.

inputVariables.symptomsSummary: Severe crushing retrosternal chest pain radiating to left jaw, diaphoresis, shortness of breath

expectedRoute: StartEvent_AppointmentRequested -> Task_ValidatePatientRegistration -> Gateway_RegistrationValid (Valid) -> Task_EvaluatePatientTriageDmn -> Gateway_TriageBranch (Urgent Assessment) -> Task_ImmediateHumanAssessment (Tasklist Emergency Form) -> EndEvent_EmergencyCareAdmitted

name: No Appointment Slots Available (Staff Waitlist Override)
description: Patient requesting specialized Radiology MRI consultation. Scheduling API returns zero available slots (capacity 100%). Gateway routes to Tasklist User Task for staff waitlist & slot override.

inputVariables.symptomsSummary: Chronic lumbar spine disc herniation evaluation

expectedRoute: StartEvent_AppointmentRequested -> Task_ValidatePatientRegistration -> Gateway_RegistrationValid (Valid) -> Task_EvaluatePatientTriageDmn -> Gateway_TriageBranch (Routine) -> Task_QueryAvailableSlotsRest [0 Slots] -> Gateway_SlotAvailability (No Slots) -> Task_StaffSlotOverrideReview (Tasklist) -> EndEvent_Waitlisted

name: Scheduling API Fails and Workflow Recovers
description: Scheduling REST API returns HTTP 500 (simulated via appointmentPreference='SIMULATE_500'). Camunda Zeebe records incident in Operate. Operator restarts mock service / retries incident to finish booking.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_AppointmentRequested -> Task_ValidatePatientRegistration -> Gateway_RegistrationValid -> Task_EvaluatePatientTriageDmn -> Task_QueryAvailableSlotsRest [INCIDENT: HTTP 500 Service Error] -> Operate Diagnostic -> Service Restored / Retried -> EndEvent_AppointmentConfirmed
